_comment: Golden record of single-robot behaviour. Regenerate ONLY via `python scripts/freeze_contract.py --write`, and only when a change to this behaviour was intended. See the module docstring.

config.description: 21x15 warehouse, two delivery tasks per episode, small starting charge and expensive movement. Tests whether a controller detours to a charger before the battery runs out.
config.name: battery_constrained

config.description: battery_constrained with a corrected reward: a depletion penalty that exceeds anything an episode can bank, a potential-based battery-reserve term, and a waiting penalty that stops camping on a charger being the cheapest way to avoid dying.
config.name: battery_tuned

config.description: 31x21 warehouse with denser shelving. Paths are longer and contain more forced detours, which is where a shaped RL policy and A* start to differ.
config.name: complex_static

config.description: 21x15 warehouse, one robot, one pickup-and-delivery task, no dynamic obstacles, battery large enough that it is not the limiting factor.
config.name: default

config.description: 21x15 warehouse with 8 randomly walking dynamic obstacles. Obstacles never step onto the robot, so every collision recorded here was caused by the controller driving into an obstacle.
config.name: dynamic_obstacles

config.description: 15x11 warehouse with a single row of shelf blocks, no dynamic obstacles and an effectively unlimited battery. Shortest paths are short and unobstructed.
config.name: simple_static
